rootCause: Codepage42 low bytes were passed through Latin-1 and high bytes rejected; font names and Word symbol private-use codes were not resolved.
fix: Retain bounded primary font names across raw/hex/Unicode font table text, discard optional destination names and unselected upr branches.
Resolve known Symbol face only; 188 standard glyphs use Unicode semantics, C0/DEL controls remain controls. Explicit cpg overrides charset.
Decode symbol byte runs and Word F020-F0FF codes using the current or last scoped symbol face; preserve ordinary Unicode and fallback token isolation.
Other symbol faces, undefined bytes and private glyph-only extenders fail explicitly while Unicode-only content and later files recover.

references.scope: Face-specific Symbol charset, Word private-use notation, font table grammar and codepage overrides.

limits: Node mocked file API and Chrome rendered actual reader tree; no WeChat or physical device claim.
Cocoa differences are retained, not normalized into equality. Symbol font recognition, PUA representation and font variants can differ.
No rich RTF font/layout fidelity or other symbol face support is implied.
Fixed charset2 named Symbol; other symbol faces do not share this map.
Unicode text extraction, not original font face/layout rendering. Private radical extender, Apple logo and undefined slots reject.
Copyright serif/sans-serif distinctions collapse to their same abstract text. Apple F87F hints are recorded in raw reference data.
Cocoa can use older private-use assignments than published mappings. Native equality is reported without adjustment.

audit: Initial exhaustive prototype treated DEL as undefined; reference header specifies standard controls. Corrected this before release and retained tab/DEL regressions.
Guarded text prevents existing document trim from being mistaken for missing space; initial unguarded reference retained only in ignored exploration.

184 glyphs match Cocoa text exactly. The vertical extender uses published Unicode U+23D0 while Cocoa emits legacy U+F8E6. Three copyright/trademark font variants share abstract Unicode text without Apple F87F style hints. DEL remains a control though Cocoa extraction omits it.

Five 24-case native differences are retained: Word private-use serialization, font variant hints, vertical extender, Cocoa ANSI upr selection and hidden text extraction. RTF specification and existing independently validated destination/hidden behavior remain the basis, not blanket Cocoa equivalence.
Actual Chrome screenshots of Greek and math body inspected; no original font face or layout pixel equivalence claimed.

First full gate had 1224/1225 Node tests pass; the new profile omitted required compatibility axes. Added actual encoding/anomaly axes, standalone profile check passed; full gate rerun passed1225/1225 plus141probes andrenderer.
limits: Named Symbol face only; Wingdings and unrelated charset2 faces remain unsupported for byte/PUA glyphs.
Radical extender and Apple logo require font rendering and remain explicit unsupported glyphs; no private font files shipped.
Rich RTF typography/font variants/layout are not newly supported.
Node uses mocked WeChat file API; Chrome uses actual reader output. WeChat DevTools and iOS/Android not run; existing compiler startup block persists.
